g.text: PF-D. Event detection by station (website scorecard cases)
Evidence A: website historical scorecard cases (overall evidence)
Model: deployed GALE-CAST Model-W1 (SHA-256 f2db5aa9…9d14b0), historical scoring procedure (_w1_recall_floor.py: pooled scaled_weather inputs, 32-day
windows); X1 = same-date mean of the three stations' scores; warning if X1 ≥ 0.601 (threshold unchanged).
Cases: the website's 3,423 next-day windows, NAIA, Sangley Point and Science Garden (1,141 each); target dates 2021-11-16 to 2024-12-30; lead +1 day.
Study label: wind ≥ 10.8 m/s OR same-station 24-h MSLP fall ≥ 3 hPa (processed values, as on the website); all 28 positives are pressure falls, 0
Baselines: event persistence = label of the issue day; event climatology = station × month label frequency, 2015-01-02 to 2020-10-14, warning if ≥
Intervals: paired circular block bootstrap over target dates, 14-day blocks, 2,000 resamples, 95% percentile.
